description: Source code implementing SSL platform key operations for macOS, including key signing and algorithm support, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeySecKey
classes.description: Implements a threaded SSL private key delegate for macOS SecKey, supporting signing operations and algorithm preferences.

methods.name: GetSecKeyAlgorithm
methods.description: Returns the corresponding SecKeyAlgorithm for a given SSL signature algorithm identifier.

methods.name: SSLPlatformKeySecKey::GetAlgorithmPreferences
methods.description: Returns the list of supported algorithm preferences.

methods.name: SSLPlatformKeySecKey::Sign
methods.description: Signs input data with the specified algorithm using the SecKey, handling PSS fallback and digest calculation.

methods.name: SSLPlatformKeySecKey::GetSecKeyAlgorithmWithFallback
methods.description: Determines the supported SecKeyAlgorithm for a given SSL algorithm, with fallback for RSA-PSS.
